name: Chip Axtell
occupation: Hot Springs County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Chip Axtell is a Hot Springs County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Paul M. Galovich, who is serving through the current term. The Thermopolis Independent Record reported that unofficial primary results showed him leading with 1,094 votes and advancing with Phillip Scheel, upsetting incumbent Galovich.
